blurb: Faith Hill Farm provides riding lessons for all skill levels, a summer camp focused on farm and nature experiences for children ages 6-12, and boarding services with a full care facility. The farm also hosts an equine-assisted learning team and corporate workshops. The Faith Hill Farm Foundation offers equine therapy and wellness services.
